newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's February electrical output rises 1.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's February electrical output rises 1.16 pct.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in February rose 1.16 percent to 1,298 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Public service firms accounted for 1,049 GWh, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 249 GWh of the country's total output.
State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power- generating public service firms, produced 462 GWh in February, down 14 percent from the same month last year.
Total electrical power output in the first two months was up 1.20 percent to 2,700 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same period last year.
